payload.rationale: UniMate's graph-Laplacian spectral RoPE generalizing position encoding to arbitrary kinematic trees is a transferable graph-attention mechanism, but the application (skeleton motion synthesis) has no direct bridge to B-rep/program generation beyond that one attention trick.
Genomic sequence diffusion modeling (variant effect prediction); no plausible bridge to B-rep/program generation, pointer networks, or verifier-guided decoding.

Reward-model-guided diffusion for medical image generation; RL fine-tuning against a reward model is loosely analogous to verifier-guided generation but the mechanism (continuous image reward shaping) and domain (medical imaging) don't transfer to discrete program/DSL synthesis.
One-shot personalized federated graph learning; unrelated to structural validity, domain gap for geometry, or pointer/graph-transformer decoding of our kind.
Radiotherapy dose reconstruction via Mamba state-space model; no methodological or application overlap with hexgen's care areas.
NLP interpretability toolkit for measuring contextual word-sense individuation in transformer LMs; no bridge to program synthesis, B-rep, or verifier-guided training.

Survey of dynamic heterogeneous graph representation learning (temporal, multi-typed networks); the representation-learning angle is graph-related but targets temporal/heterogeneous social-style graphs, not static small face-adjacency graphs or program decoding - too generic a bridge.

Proposes replacing token-level autoregressive sampling with deterministic graph-based latent computation specifically to curb error accumulation in AR decoding - a genuine (if indirect) methodological bridge to structural validity of autoregressively generated programs, our top care-area.
Cross-view (ground-to-satellite) image localization using BEV geometry; no bridge to B-rep, program synthesis, or graph/pointer decoding.
Survey of wireless/physical-layer foundation models; unrelated application and mechanism.

Hierarchical graph POINTER network that selects (points to) a candidate receiver node among graph-structured, partially-observed candidates - architecturally close to our pointer/copy heads addressing faces of an input graph, despite the unrelated football-analytics application.
Security-context composition framework for LLM agent tool/policy chains; no bridge to geometric program generation or verifier-guided structural validity in our sense.

Single-domain-generalization method using diffusion-augmented, DRO-selected hard samples to close the gap between one labeled source domain and unseen target domains - directly analogous to our domain-gap / data-diversity-vs-volume care area, even though applied to image classification rather than geometry generation.
Comparative study of counterfactual explainers for GNNs via graph edits; explainability-focused, not generation or verification of programs/meshes - weak bridge at best.

Domain-generalization technique for cross-cancer pathology classification using biologically-motivated immune-topology descriptors; the generalization framing is relevant in spirit but the mechanism is deeply histology-specific with no transferable component for geometric/program generation.
Survey of diffusion language models for mobile-edge agentic AI; non-autoregressive decoding for edge deployment, no bridge to our structural-validity or B-rep concerns.

On-policy distillation for tool-using agents that explicitly addresses teacher-student drift once the student's own tool calls execute and shape later context - a direct analog to our DAgger-style repair/edit distillation and verifier-in-the-loop training care areas, despite the different (LLM tool-use) application.

Builds a hierarchical skill library from LLM-agent execution traces via spectral graph methods; interesting graph technique but aimed at skill retrieval/summarization, not structural validity, verification, or program decoding of the kind we care about.

SQL-Zero is a proposer-solver self-play system trained purely from execution feedback against a real database (no annotated pairs), with GRPO updates on both roles - essentially the same self-play / verifier-in-the-loop / program-synthesis-via-execution-feedback paradigm we use for hexgen, just in the text-to-SQL domain.

Combines a frozen symbolic verifier (FOL/Z3, physics solver) with group-relative RLVR to train against verifiable rewards - methodologically close to our rejection-sampled training against a frozen machine-checkable verifier, even though the task is educational QA rather than program synthesis.
Air-quality spatiotemporal GNN regression; no bridge to our care areas.

Feature-readout guidance for steering diffusion-transformer image/video generation; control mechanism is for continuous visual generation, not discrete structured program/mesh synthesis - no clear transfer.
Temporal residual NeRF for monocular dynamic human body reconstruction; unrelated to program synthesis or B-rep graphs.

WEECFP-SuRGE applies a RoPE-like rotary positional encoding parameterized by graph shortest-path distance inside transformer self-attention over molecular substructure tokens - a direct instance of the Graphormer-style edge-biased graph-transformer attention we explicitly care about, despite the cheminformatics application.

Pocket-conditioned autoregressive 3D molecular generation with a permutation-invariant set transformer; the autoregressive, order-invariant generation over a structured set echoes our pointer/symmetry concerns, but there is no verifier-in-the-loop, grammar-constrained decoding, or B-rep-like structure making the bridge concrete enough.

SeamFlow is a structured generative framework (flow matching over edge probabilities) for cutting/UV-unwrapping driven by mesh topology awareness - a genuine bridge to our neural-mesh-generation and structured/schema-constrained generation care areas, even though the target task (UV seams) differs from hex-meshing.
GNN ownership verification via watermarking/fingerprinting; unrelated to our problem.

Addresses domain heterogeneity (CAD vs. scanned point clouds) in 3D class-incremental learning; domain-gap framing is conceptually related but the mechanism (incremental classification over point-cloud sources) doesn't transfer to conditional B-rep-to-program generation.

Think-Verify-Revise couples a VLM proposer with a differentiable symbolic verifier (Dynamic Logic Tensor Network) in a closed generate-verify-revise loop - directly analogous to our verifier-in-the-loop / repair-distillation care areas, despite the visual-reasoning application.
Interpretable random-walk graph fingerprints for power-grid cascading-failure classification; no plausible bridge to program synthesis or B-rep representation learning.

Embedded Graph Flows is a permutation-equivariant graph-transformer generative model that learns continuous category embeddings and flow-matches toward discrete node/edge types - directly relevant to B-rep/CAD graph representation learning and structured graph generation, both explicit care areas.
Differentiable skinning-weight gradients for deforming Gaussian splats; mesh-free deformation for animation, no bridge to hex-meshing or B-rep program synthesis.
Sound-based multi-person 3D pose estimation; unrelated application and mechanism.

Discovery Loop is an LLM-driven program-evolution system where candidate algorithms are screened by an independent verifier and kept/discarded - essentially the same best-of-N, verifier-screened self-improvement flywheel we use for hexgen, applied to circle-packing instead of mesh programs.

RL framework with a GNN policy searching quantum circuit architectures for semiconductor device modeling; the GNN+RL search pattern is superficially similar to search-guided generation but the application and reward signal (device MAE) have no concrete transfer to our structural-validity or verifier problems.
Zero-shot 6D pose estimation front-end using linguistic semantic memory for object proposals; unrelated to our care areas.
Learned camera-view selection for VLM-based 3D visual grounding; no bridge to B-rep, program synthesis, or graph/pointer decoding.
